lines: Even if I try to speak, I lack the words
My open mouth just won't close
Even if I stay silent, words aren't needed
Is the result of insects beginning to eat
Still flying out of the atmosphere itself
What gradually grows smaller directly below
Is the town where you were
Flowers bloomed at the tips of my shoes
I'll go, leaving my heart behind
Even if I try to know you, I'm indecisive
Because I'd surely put on airs
But the sky is beautiful today, too
Is surely the price for life
I, who am too late now
What I wish for is a foolish question
The eyes that reflect you are a hindrance
I end up crying just from the sound
Even if I try to fly through the sky, there's no end to it
Because I'd surely end up searching for you
Escaping even this planet's present moment
What vanished was the town where you were
Flowers bloomed in the summer sky
I want to keep crying forever
